bio: Temporarily closed.Located in the RaumFabrik business park, FINE is TAWA YAMA's stylish fine dining restaurant. The modern cuisine abounds with original ideas, with subtle dishes taking inspiration from the Far Eastern pantry, as in the hamachi served with oyster cream, yuzu koshō and leek. The set menu is made up of four to seven courses during the week and five to seven courses at the weekend – upgrades are possible. A vegetarian set menu is also available by prior arrangement. In a fittingly modern and sophisticated interior, diners can opt for seats that afford a view through a window into the kitchen. The friendly front-of-house team provides enjoyably unobtrusive service, while the sommelier helps with the wine selection. Incidentally, the Japanese name TAWA YAMA means tower mountain...
